column1: # Game profile of Batman: Arkham Asylum (Switch, update 1.0.1 = v65536). Plays on the Mac
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file
# Rocksteady's Unreal Engine 3 (package version 0x243, licensee 0x15, Oodle chunks) with FMOD, Scaleform menus and Bink movies, SDK 14.3.0, NVN.
# The shaders are compact records without stored NVN control sections, including inline two-module VertexA+VertexB vertex programs (shader_split.py ue3_compact_shaders; README.md, Files and shaders).
# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID
# main sets a heap of at most the pool - 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource (IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false)
# The game selects near-zero NVN depth (nvnDeviceSetDepthMode near = 0 at boot); offline pipeline bases use main0_z.
# The game writes into texture storage from the CPU without flushing (README.md, What it needs: 234,144 writes against 485 re-uploads, stale HUD sprite with them off).
# tex_dirty_upload needs tex_flush_upload on. Both default off, and a provisional profile never guesses them.
